headline: Coinhub Funded Launches Crypto Proprietary Trading Accounts
summary: Coinhub Funded has gone live, offering crypto proprietary trading accounts with funding up to $200,000 alongside 30-minute tournaments.
why: Proprietary trading firms catering to retail crypto participants influence trading volumes and liquidity in digital asset markets.

impacts.why: The crypto proprietary trading firm launched its funded accounts.
